description: This file defines the PersistableOrderProduct class, which extends OrderProductEntity and implements Serializable. It encapsulates details about an order product, including price and attributes.

classes.name: PersistableOrderProduct
classes.description: A serializable class representing an order product with price and attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of product attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of product attributes.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the product.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the product.
